source_strategy: Public multilingual web search and public-page reading across official operator announcements and credible local or trade press, emphasizing newly launched or materially expanded consumer, lifestyle, wellness, social, dating, retail, and hospitality formats dated 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-30 without applying recommendation or adoption judgments.

leads.raw_description: Tinder expanded its in-app Events feature from a Los Angeles pilot into nine additional U.S. and European cities. The format connects app discovery with third-party-operated offline activities such as ceramics, brunches, hikes, runs, game nights, music, yoga, pickleball, brewery meetups and coffee socials; users can express interest, see other interested users, RSVP or buy tickets, check in for an Attended badge, and match after the shared event.
leads.discovered_via: English-language public search for newly expanded in-person dating and social formats, followed by Tinder's official pressroom announcement.
leads.market: United States and Europe / Los Angeles pilot; New York City, Dallas, Denver, Kansas City, Phoenix, Berlin, Munich, Zurich and Geneva rollout
raw_dates: Los Angeles pilot launched in March 2026
raw_numbers: 66% of eligible active Los Angeles users engaged with Events
71% engagement among ages 18-24 versus 63% among ages 25+
60-person candlelight ceramics class sold out within one day
Photo Verification required for full access
uncertainties: All engagement and retention figures are Tinder internal data from Photo Verified active users in the Los Angeles pilot and may not represent other markets.
The announcement does not list all 26 planned September markets or a city-by-city launch date.
Independent organizers, rather than Tinder, create, manage and ticket the underlying experiences.
No ticket prices, event inventory or live city-level availability were verified.

leads.raw_description: Indian ergonomics and comfort brand Frido launched 15 company-operated experiential stores across five metropolitan markets. The outlets are presented as experience hubs where shoppers physically test Home, Walk, Work, Orthotics and Mobility products; selected locations add in-house podiatrist guidance, and Frido's public experience-store surface advertises 3D foot scans, gait analysis and personalized recommendations.
leads.discovered_via: English-language Indian retail-trade search for newly accelerated experiential wellness retail, cross-read with Frido's public experience-store locator.
leads.market: India / Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune
raw_numbers: 3D foot scan or gait analysis advertised as taking 10-15 minutes
uncertainties: The trade report does not provide the individual first-trading date for each of the 15 stores.
In-house podiatrists are available only at selected locations, but the complete eligible-store list was not stated in the coverage.
The exact mix of diagnostic services and product inventory may vary by location.
The 70-100-store and job figures are company plans rather than completed expansion.

leads.raw_description: Michaels opened a third location of its next-generation experiential store model in Rogers, Arkansas after Easton, Ohio and Irving, Texas. The format combines themed shopping worlds with physical-to-digital sampling, visible service production, personalization bars, hands-on creative stations, parties, classes and community events; Michaels said the stores are test environments for elements intended to scale across its wider network.
leads.discovered_via: English-language public search for experiential retail formats materially expanded during August 2026, followed by Michaels' official pressroom release.
leads.market: United States / Rogers, Arkansas; Easton, Ohio; Irving, Texas
raw_dates: additional concept stores and enhanced legacy-store elements planned during 2026
Marker Bar planned for all stores by the end of August 2026
raw_numbers: 1,000 online fabric samples represented in the Swatch Bar
1,300+ Michaels stores across 49 U.S. states and Canada
uncertainties: The release announces the Rogers opening but does not separately state its first public trading date or floor area.
The number and locations of additional 2026 concept stores were not specified.
Which pilot elements will be adopted chainwide, beyond the planned Marker Bar, remained unresolved.
Prices and services may differ after the announcement date.

leads.raw_title: Kämp Spa and Kämp Spa Members' Club
leads.raw_description: Hotel Kämp introduced a 1,200-square-metre Helsinki wellbeing format combining Finnish sauna traditions and hospitality with cryotherapy, Neurosonic beds, compression therapy, cold plunge, functional beverages, personalized programs and a limited-membership club. The launch was phased between hotel-guest spa access and a year-round members' club positioned around recovery, vitality and social connection.
leads.discovered_via: Public multilingual search for new European wellness and hospitality formats, followed by Hotel Kämp's official opening announcement.
raw_dates: 2026-07-15 early treatment booking and spa access for hotel guests
uncertainties: The announcement does not disclose the membership cap, membership price, treatment prices or floor-by-floor capacity.
The source is the operator's own launch announcement and provides no independent utilization figures.
Availability for non-hotel guests without membership was not fully described.
The phrase evidence-based wellness is an operator characterization; no clinical outcome evidence was supplied on the page.

leads.raw_title: 炉端会席 KAKU 品川 table-side irori dining format
leads.raw_description: DD Group's Diamond Dining opened a new 100-seat restaurant format in Shinagawa that reconstructs traditional irori hearth culture for modern dining. Every table has a charcoal hearth; chefs cook robata and straw-smoked dishes in front of guests, while set-course service, in-house rice polishing and hagama rice combine cooking spectacle with shared-fire social dining.
leads.discovered_via: Japanese-language search for 2026 新業態 and 体験型 restaurant openings, followed by the operator-authored launch release.
possible_entities: 炉端会席 KAKU 品川
ダイヤモンドダイニング
raw_numbers: 5-minute walk from Shinagawa Station Konan exit
uncertainties: The format description and social effects are operator claims from a press release.
No post-opening utilization, repeat-visit or independent customer data were available in the inspected source.
Menus and operating details were explicitly subject to change.
Live reservation inventory was not checked.

leads.raw_description: Bandung-based JUN matcha club expanded to Jakarta with a compact 33-square-metre hospitality format built around visible matcha preparation as the central ritual. The space uses a transitional seating zone, Zen-garden-inspired circulation, a semi-secluded lava-stone preparation counter, locally sourced materials and Indonesian craft elements including indigo-dyed fabric, recycled coffee-ground panels, handcrafted paper and banana-fibre paper.
leads.discovered_via: Indonesian and English-language search for recently expanded Southeast Asian café and social hospitality concepts, followed by global retail-and-hospitality editorial coverage linking the operator account.
leads.market: Indonesia / Jakarta / Kebayoran Baru, with an earlier base in Bandung
uncertainties: The editorial page says the Jakarta branch recently opened but does not state an exact first-trading date.
The publication timestamp was inferred from the dated editorial index rather than displayed in the readable article body.
No menu prices, seating capacity or visit counts were disclosed.
The opening represents an expansion from Bandung, but the number and chronology of earlier branches were not established.
